binding_defect_ideal_wind_branch.scope: Optimistic new ledger, not measured merger release or Q flux. Core and A held fixed; rest defect taken from noncore allocation. Inefficiency must escape through a separately accounted channel, not heat stars.

directed_radiation_J_branch.scope: Optimally directed positive-energy freely propagating radiation at Rc. No measured radiation spectrum, Q, or global chirality/torque. Not an exact extended endpoint solution.

advected_only_radiation_branch.scope: Radiation has zero net momentum and intrinsic J in emitter COM. Emission from within Rc; excludes intrinsic/multipole radiation J and anisotropic recoil.

intrinsic_spin_branch.scope: Positive-energy causal compact-object spin bound; cold escapers. Illustrative mh1MeV mapping only, not a derived carrier mass or exclusion of all spectra.

fixed_global_stellar_snapshot_margin.scope: Selected old endpoint and fixed tracer profile only. Guard near saturation by construction, not universal heating bound. Re aperture and actual observational weighting unresolved.
